title: Generative News Recommendation Reproduces Popularity: A Memorization-Based Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.25606v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-based generative recommenders can go beyond ranking existing items by directly generating item titles or other textual representations. In the news domain, this raises a societal concern that models may repeatedly surface already popular articles and thereby narrow the diversity of information to which users are exposed. We investigate training-data memorization as one mechanism behind this concentration. Using approximately 20 million browsing sessions from a Japanese news service, we continually trained an instruction-tuned Llama 3 8B model to generate the next article title in a session. The generated-title distribution was more concentrated and less diverse than the distribution of titles observed in the browsing logs. Frequently repeated target titles exhibited greater verbatim and approximate memorization, and more strongly memorized titles were generated in response to a wider range of prompts. translated_title: 生成式新闻推荐再现流行度：基于记忆化的分析
translated_abstract: 基于文本的生成式推荐器能够通过直接生成物品标题或其他文本表示，超越对现有物品进行排序。在新闻领域，这引发了一个社会层面的担忧：模型可能反复推送本已热门的文章，从而缩小用户接触信息的多样性。我们将训练数据记忆化作为导致这种集中现象的机制之一加以研究。利用来自日本某新闻服务的约2000万条浏览会话数据，我们对一个经过指令微调的Llama 3 8B模型进行持续训练，使其生成会话中的下一篇新闻标题。研究发现，生成标题的分布比浏览日志中实际观察到的标题分布更加集中、多样性更低。频繁重复出现的目标标题表现出更强的逐字记忆与近似记忆，而记忆化程度越高的标题，会在越广泛的提示（上下文）中被生成。这些发现支持一条……
tldr: 该研究利用约2000万条日本新闻浏览会话数据，首次从训练数据记忆化的角度揭示生成式新闻推荐再现流行内容的机制——被频繁点击的新闻标题更容易被模型记住，并在更多样化的用户上下文中被生成，从而导致信息多样性下降。
en_tdlr: Using approximately 20 million browsing sessions from a Japanese news service, this study reveals memorization of frequently repeated article titles as a key mechanism by which generative news recommenders reproduce popularity and narrow information diversity.
